name: streamb10
description: The Lander's streamB10.sh and its Jet twin StreamB10.jet (#5072 c15, c9): wait for batch A's stage-1 compiler, make it a seed, and hand batch B's staged SUBs to integrate10.sh (the twin to Integrate10.jet); the fixtures hold the batches, the admitted seed and a stand-in Integrate10.jet that writes what it was given and found (the stand-in integrate10.sh runs it, so both sides get the same step), and check.jet prints those facts and what the report names.
